version: prospective extension after first-batch exploratory open-set pilot
source: same complete funneled LFW archive used by first batch
evaluation_identities: the same frozen 128 identities with six images each
selection: uniform random permutation of all remaining identities with at least one image; first 512 calibration, next 512 test unknown, remainder distractor pool
image_selection: one uniformly sampled image per new identity, using the frozen seed; no quality or recognition based selection
gallery_construction: 128 original enrolled prototypes plus a nested prefix of disjoint distractor identities; never enroll calibration or test unknown identities
threshold_rules: conservative one-sided binomial order statistic at confidence .95 under IID identity sampling
do_not_claim: 0.1% FPIR reliably estimated from 512 unknown identities
that the old frequent-identity hard pilot and the new all-identity population are interchangeable
report: index candidate recall and exhaustive agreement
